_note: Specification-level flow definition, not a pac-exported artifact — no tenant to build this in yet (docs/09-build-report.md).
description: Updates the asset's derived calibration dates when a calibration record is saved, and — if the asset was in the lab — brings it home through the normal transaction mechanism rather than an admin setting status by hand (feature 004 FR-024).

actions.name: Recompute_asset_calibration_dates
actions.detail: List every eng_calibrationrecord for this asset, take the one with the latest eng_calibrationdate (NOT the most recently created — feature 004 FR-012/FR-013), set eng_asset.eng_lastcaldate/eng_nextcaldue from it.
actions.derivesFrom: api/mock/index.ts: MockAmsBackend.recordCalibration() — `store.calibrationRecords.filter(...).reduce((a,b) => a.calibrationdate > b.calibrationdate ? a : b)`

actions.name: Return_from_calibration_if_needed
actions.detail: If eng_asset.eng_status = InCalibration: create one eng_transaction (type ReturnFromCalibration, performedby = the calibration record's creator) and its line. F1 then derives the asset back to Available at its home office. Never sets eng_status directly.
actions.derivesFrom: api/mock/index.ts: MockAmsBackend.recordCalibration() — calls `store.applyTransaction({ transactiontype: 'ReturnFromCalibration', ... })` exactly when the asset's status is InCalibration.
